name: Let's Go, Saury-Saury Scout!
description: Thanks to recent exchanges with friends from different nations, Mika from the Reconnaissance Company has reached a new milestone...

dialogs.content: Wow, young Knight, looks like you've brought our great hero over!
It's our Honorary Knight and the Helper in White! Greetings!
Mika and... a friend from Natlan? What are you guys doing here?
We're here to get the word out about something called the Saury-Saury Scout. We think it's something adventurers will find really useful.
It combines the mechanical core of the Scouting Buddy that Amber brought back from Sumeru with the adorable appearance of the little saurian toy my friends from Natlan gave me.
Scouting Buddy... Oh, yeah, Paimon remembers!
Just like the Scouting Buddies from Sumeru, the Saury-Saury Scout can be used to perform monster recon and survey unfamiliar terrain.
But due to our focus being on the latter, the Saury-Saury Scout is designed with a greater emphasis on controllability and precision of movement.
...Are you interested in taking it on a test flight, Honorary Knight?
That was a very serious introduction.
Huh? Perhaps I was a little bit nervous just now...
That must be it... I could swear I was more relaxed around you before.
It's just that I've been hearing so many stories about you from friends in other nations lately — your deeds are getting more and more exceptional...
Every time I think about how I need to be helpful and not get in your way, I can't help but tense up again.
That's such a Mika thing to say...
You're doing very well, young Knight!
#Sometimes, in Natlan, when a warrior from our tribe runs into {NICKNAME}, they get so excited they just start blabbering. I've even seen folks get so overwhelmed, they can't get a single word out!
#As someone who works alongside {NICKNAME}, you're basically a legend yourself. There's no need for you to be nervous, even when talking to our chief!
That's right! You should have more faith in yourself, Mika!
Hmm... I've never really thought about it from that point of view before...

#Anyway, {NICKNAME}, if you test out the Saury-Saury Scout and find it makes the grade, then we'll know for sure that it's a reliable, adorable mechanism that can be a big help to all sorts of adventurers!
I'm a bit of a testing expert!
Fantastic! Let me just make a few final tweaks, and then you're good to go!
Let's see what this Saury-Saury can do!
There's no need to be so formal.
